info.title: IntelliGRC API
info.description:
### Overview
The **IntelliGRC API** enables clients to interact with their data within the **IntelliGRC platform**.  
This API provides endpoints to **retrieve, update, and manage** compliance and risk-related information.

### Authentication
All API requests must be authenticated using an **API Credential** generated within IntelliGRC.  
Each request requires the following headers:

- `x-client-id` → Your unique **Client ID**.
- `x-client-secret` → Your **Client Secret** (keep this confidential).

For endpoints that require tenant context, you must also include:
- `x-tenant-id` → A valid **Tenant ID** (GUID format).

### Getting Started
1. **Authenticate**
   - Include your `x-client-id` and `x-client-secret` (and `x-tenant-id` when required) in the request headers.

2. **Make API Requests**
   - Use the API endpoints to interact with your IntelliGRC data.

3. **Explore Endpoints**
   - The available endpoints are documented below.

### Support
For support, please email us at support@intelligrc.com or visit our [Support Page](https://intelligrc.zendesk.com/).

get.description:
Retrieves all assessment objectives and their current status for the given framework and evaluation id.
If an evaluation id is not provided, the current evaluation will be used.
If a framework id is provided, the assessment objectives returned will be filtered by the framework and include their framework specific names.
If a framework id is not provided, and the evaluation provided has multiple frameworks, all assessment objectives will be returned with their Intelligent Control Library (ICL) ids.
